自由五子规则（长连也算胜）: Freestyle Gomoku rules (overlines count as a win)
棋种 id；使用路径形式 /api/v1/games/gomoku/move 时: Game ID; may be omitted when using the path form /api/v1/games/gomoku/move.
长度 225 的行优先数组；空格用空字符串。: Row-major array of length 225; use an empty string for empty intersections.
落子交叉点下标 0–224；index = row*15 + col。: Placement intersection index 0–224; index = row*15 + col.
board 长度必须是 225；index = row*15 + col，row: board must have length 225; index = row*15 + col, with row 0 as the top row.
自由五子规则：连续五子或更多即获胜，没有禁手限制。: Freestyle rules: five or more stones in a row wins; there are no forbidden moves.
落子位置必须是空格；已有棋子的 index 会返回 BAD_MOVE/INVAL: The move must be on an empty intersection; an index already occupied by a stone returns BAD_MOVE/INVALID_MOVE.
双方都无子可下时结束，棋子多者获胜，相同为和棋。: Ends when neither side has a legal move; the player with more pieces wins, and an equal count is a draw.
自动跳过无子可下的一方: Automatically skips a side with no legal move
棋种 id；使用路径形式 /api/v1/games/reversi/move: Game ID; may be omitted when using the path form /api/v1/games/reversi/move.
长度 64 的行优先数组；空格用空字符串。: Row-major array of length 64; use an empty string for empty squares.
落子格子下标 0–63；必须能翻转至少一枚对方棋子。: Placement square index 0–63; must flip at least one opponent piece.
board 长度必须是 64；index = row*8 + col，row 0: board must have length 64; index = row*8 + col, with row 0 as the top row.
只有能翻转至少一枚对方棋子的落点才是合法走法。: Only moves that flip at least one opponent piece are legal.
一方无子可下时引擎自动跳过；响应 status 会反映轮次变化，客户端继续用返回: When one side has no legal move, the engine skips it automatically; the response status reflects the turn change, and the client can keep requesting with the returned turn.
棋种 id；使用路径形式 /api/v1/games/connect4/move: Game ID; may be omitted when using the path form /api/v1/games/connect4/move.
长度 42 的行优先数组；空格用空字符串。: Row-major array of length 42; use an empty string for empty squares.
落点格子下标 0–41；必须是该列最下方的空位。: Target square index 0–41; must be the lowest empty slot in that column.
board 长度必须是 42；index = row*7 + col，row 0: board must have length 42; index = row*7 + col, with row 0 as the top row.
落子必须落在该列最下方的空位；建议直接用合法走法返回的 index。: The move must land in the lowest empty slot of that column; using the index returned by legal moves is recommended.
胜负判定覆盖横、竖和两条斜线。: Win detection covers horizontal, vertical, and both diagonals.
策略类 · Jungle Chess (Dou Shou Qi): Strategy Games · Jungle Chess (Dou Shou Qi)
进入对方陷阱的兽战力变为 0。: A piece entering an opponent's trap has its strength reduced to 0.
进入对方兽穴立即获胜；一方无子可走也判负。: Entering the opponent's den wins immediately; a player with no legal move also loses.
棋种 id；使用路径形式 /api/v1/games/jungle/move 时: Game ID; may be omitted when using the path form /api/v1/games/jungle/move.
长度 63 的行优先数组；空格用空字符串。: Row-major array of length 63; use an empty string for empty squares.
起点扁平下标 0–62。: Flat index of the start square, 0–62.
终点扁平下标 0–62。: Flat index of the destination square, 0–62.
board 长度必须是 63；row 0 为黑方底线（上方），index = r: board must have length 63; row 0 is Black's back row (top), index = row*7 + col.
棋子编码为颜色+兽名，如 rE（红象）、bR（黑鼠）；空位为 \"\"。: Pieces are encoded as color + animal, e.g. rE (Red Elephant) and bR (Black Rat); an empty square is "".
河流、陷阱、兽穴、鼠吃象、狮虎跳河都由规则处理；移动用 from/to 两个扁平: Rivers, traps, dens, the rat capturing the elephant, and lion/tiger river jumps are all handled by the rules; moves use the two flat indices from/to.
先把自己的 10 枚棋子全部走进对面角的阵营者获胜。: The first player to move all 10 pieces into the opposite corner wins.
一方无任何合法走法时判负。: A player with no legal move loses.
十子归营判胜: Win by getting all ten pieces across
棋种 id；使用路径形式 /api/v1/games/checkers/move: Game ID; may be omitted when using the path form /api/v1/games/checkers/move.
长度 121 的行优先数组；空格用空字符串。: Row-major array of length 121; use an empty string for empty holes.
终点孔位编号 0–120；单步或一次跳跃。: End hole index 0–120; a single step or one jump.
board 长度必须是 121；孔位按 17 行排列，行孔数为 1,2,3,4,: board must have length 121; holes are arranged in 17 rows, with 1,2,3,4,13,12,11,10,9,10,11,12,13,4,3,2,1 holes per row.
移动用 from/to 两个孔位编号；跳跃可以跨越任意颜色棋子，被跨越的棋子不动: Moves use two hole indices from/to; a jump may pass over pieces of any color, and the jumped pieces stay in place.
连跳按引擎返回的当前一步应用；如果还有后续跳跃，下一次合法走法会继续给出。: Apply chain jumps one step at a time as returned by the engine; if further jumps remain, the next legal move will provide them.
先把 10 枚棋子全部走进对面角阵营者获胜；无合法走法判负。: The first player to move all 10 pieces into the opposite corner wins; a player with no legal move loses.
